notes: M.G.L. c. 186 § 12 governs notice to determine an estate at will: notice periods (three months or the rent interval/30 days), a 14-day notice to quit for nonpayment, a 10-day right to cure once per 12 months, required notice language, and court continuances for delayed government payments. These rules govern how a tenancy is ended (notice-to-quit periods, forms, timing, cure), not whether the landlord may end it, so they are out of scope under the just_cause_eviction definition. No rule in the six categories was extracted. A reviewer may consider whether the 10-day cure right should be treated as a limit on eviction.
